raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely resolved the “Rostov” ambiguity by assuming it referred to Rostov-on-Don based on modern default usage, despite the context being a 16th-century Orthodox saint. This ignored historical facts (Rostov-on-Don was founded later) and cues from sources (Orthodox/encyclopedic snippets) pointing to Rostov the Great (Rostov Veliky) in Yaroslavl Oblast. The error was a premature, unverified disambiguation without confirming the correct Rostov, leading toward the wrong territorial entity.
